cards.title: SHARED BODY · all three
cards.text:
Your colon is a muscle, and it only contracts when it gets a signal. That signal is a short-chain fatty acid called butyrate, made by the bacteria in your colon out of the fiber that reaches them.

A GLP-1 works by slowing digestion down. That is the point, and it works. The trouble is that the slowdown reaches all the way to the colon. Less material gets down to the bacteria, fewer of them survive, less butyrate gets made, and the muscle gets a weaker signal. Slower colon, so even less reaches them tomorrow. It feeds on itself, and the medication holds that first slowdown in place, which is what keeps the loop shut.

That is why this gets worse over time instead of settling down. You are not failing to adjust to anything.

Weight loss lives in one system, the brain and the appetite, and that is the dial the medication turns. This lives in a different system, the colon and the bacteria in it. Because they are separate, you can rebuild the gut without touching the weight loss. You do not have to come off the medication.

Fiber alone falls short here. It is food for bacteria that have already been starved down, so it piles up in a colon that is not moving and bloats you worse by evening. Laxatives force one movement and rebuild nothing.

Motilli does the two things that have to happen together. Concentrated celery juice standardized for a real dose of apigenin, which barely absorbs into the bloodstream and so stays down in the colon where the work is. Plus a fine soluble fiber that feeds the butyrate makers specifically, without the coarse bulk that bloats.

Three gummies before bed with a full glass of water. Not a laxative, so the first few days are quiet. The first normal, non-cramping movement usually lands around day five and fills in from there.

Ninety days to decide. Email inside ninety days and every dollar comes back, no return required.

cards.title: COPY AUDIT
cards.text:
Two separate systems: present in every ad, as the mechanism bible requires. This is the belief the copy exists to install.

Law 9: two blockers caught and fixed before render. 'so the loop does not break on its own / That is why' and 'Fiber alone will not do it. It is food for...' both tripped the negation-affirmation rule. Rewritten to 'which is what keeps the loop shut' and 'Fiber alone falls short here.'

Law 2: no invented study, percentage, doctor or customer quote. No specific weight-loss number in the copy.

Swap test: PASS. Copy argues against fiber, laxatives and probiotics by mechanism.

Shelf life: evergreen.

VERIFY BEFORE LAUNCH: the 90-day no-return-required guarantee wording against the live policy page.
